Liz (AE): Quick heads-up — Kestrel Finance wants us to run a short onboarding/POC focused on enterprise auth.
They're asking: SAML IdP metadata, SCIM provisioning (bulk delta support), RBAC mapping to AD groups, and domain proofing (DNS + email). Need a POC runbook and a ballpark cost for Hosted vs Dedicated. Can someone lead?

Samir (SE): I can drive the runbook. Suggest POC plan: 1) metadata exchange, 2) SCIM sync test with ~100 users, 3) RBAC mapping via group imports, 4) domain proof + lock. Estimate 2 full days of SE time + infra.

Ana (Security): They'll also need SOC2 evidence and KMS integration notes. Ask them to fill our security questionnaire — specifically Q14 (key management) + Q21 (data residency). I can prep answers.

Liz (AE): Thanks. Also they're asking about throttling — SCIM delta rate. What's our standard guidance?

Jordan (Eng): Default SCIM rate is 10 reqs/sec; for delta we can suggest 100/min with exponential backoff. We should document idempotency expectations for the customer.

Samir (SE): Example RBAC mapping we usually share: map AD groups -> Redwood roles (viewer/editor/admin), import attributes: memberOf, email. We'll provide a sample mapping file.

Liz (AE): On pricing, they want quick comparison: Hosted POC vs Dedicated pilot. Any ballparks?

Samir (SE): Hosted — pay-as-you-go. Small POC (low concurrency): ~$5k total (SE hours + usage). Dedicated pilot — reserved pool + onboarding: typical starter commitment is ~$40k/mo (includes reserved GPU and priority routing) but can be adjusted. I'll confirm exact numbers with pricing.

Ana (Security): Also, customer asked about tenant takeover prevention. Recommend: DNS TXT proof + org-admin email validation + optional SAML assertion binding to verify IDP.

Liz (AE): Can someone surface any enterprise blockers we should flag to legal/finance?

Jordan (Eng): Data residency: they want EU-only data for token storage. Private deployment or VPC option needed. Also KMS integration for envelope encryption.

Samir (SE): Operational blockers: SCIM deltas and provisioning gaps — we should run a delta stress test during POC. Also RBAC edge cases where users are in 50+ groups; need group-expansion policy.

Ana (Security): I'll attach SOC2 summary and KMS integration notes to the questionnaire answers. Also flag exporting audit logs (retention and access) as a question for their compliance team.

Liz (AE): Action items checklist for customer email (short matrix):
- Deliverables: IdP metadata exchange, SCIM test sync, RBAC mapping file, domain proofing steps, security questionnaire answers
- Timeline: kickoff + 1 week runbook + 1 week test sync
- Costs: Hosted POC (est $5k) vs Dedicated pilot (est $40k/mo start) + SE hours estimate
- Blockers: data residency, KMS/HSM, SCIM throttle limits

Samir (SE): I'll draft the runbook and a sample SCIM dataset by EOD tomorrow.

Ana (Security): I'll populate the security questionnaire and attach certs in 2 days.

Jordan (Eng): I'll produce an RBAC mapping example and exact SCIM rate guidance by EOD today.

Liz (AE): I'll schedule kickoff for tomorrow 10am PT and send the matrix to the customer.

EngBot: Deploy check passed for test account provisioning pipeline :white_check_mark:

Samir (SE): Pinged the doc draft in the sales folder, link: https://redwood.team/sales/docs/1773008888-runbook

Liz (AE): Awesome, thanks everyone :rocket:
